revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Reviewed 20261127 MCI string status options only: search the lowercased token suffix after verb and device, preserving length > position > mode > tracks priority; resolve the first track qualifier in that same suffix using its original token index. No open/type/alias namespace, callback producer, notification delivery, scheduling, export reentry, guest restoration, memory write or ownership lifetime changes. Public createHostImports/mci_string with actual VirtualFS and literal valid format-0 MIDI reproduces keyword-alias failures before repair; guarded return buffers, same-device numeric string and MCI_STATUS controls, ordinary aliases, compound open and close pass after repair (20261127-mci-status-options-repair-root). CD track indexing reviewed statically only; no CD runtime qualification or Windows behavior claim. Existing callback ownership remains pending.
